product.name: LoopLite
product.one_liner: Minimal habit tracker with streak widgets
product.audience: Busy adults who abandon complex habit apps

assumptions: Creator can use Google Play billing and AdMob in their region
Primary market is English-speaking Android users

coverage.notes: Sampled lib/ features; no iOS project reviewed

categories.summary: Clear pain: complex habit apps overwhelm
categories.why: Busy adults abandon multi-feature habit apps; LoopLite targets streaks-only.
categories.why_not_higher: No primary interviews or review quotes proving willingness to switch.

evidence.quote: Minimal habit tracker for people who quit complex apps

categories.summary: Streaks-only angle exists but weakly owned
categories.why: Competes with Loop Habit Tracker and Streaks on the same core loop; uniqueness is thin.
categories.why_not_higher: Needs a hard wedge (offline widgets, privacy, or niche workflow) vs named peers.

evidence.quote: Simple streaks. No RPG. No social.

categories.summary: Ads present without frequency caps or consent
categories.why: AdMob interstitial helper exists; no cap and no UMP flow found.
categories.why_not_higher: Add consent, caps, and a believable paid tier or rewarded-only path.

categories.why: Single screenshot shows default purple Material primary and uneven spacing.
categories.why_not_higher: Custom palette, type scale, and consistent 8dp spacing across screens.

evidence.quote: Default purple AppBar; dense list tiles

categories.why: Notification permission requested on first frame before any habit is created.
categories.why_not_higher: Defer permissions until the user schedules a reminder.

categories.summary: Streaks exist; no return trigger beyond local notifs
categories.why: Habit model stores streakCount; no meaningful re-engagement beyond permission ask.
categories.why_not_higher: Widget + smart reminder cadence with measured D1/D7.

categories.summary: Listing draft is thin; no share surface
categories.why: Short listing text; no screenshots set in repo; no invite/share.
categories.why_not_higher: Full store assets + one referral or share-streak action.

evidence.quote: Simple streaks. No RPG. No social.

categories.why: Feature folders exist; one widget test; Crashlytics absent.
categories.why_not_higher: Add crash reporting and tests around streak edge cases.

categories.summary: Privacy policy link missing; broad permissions
categories.why: INTERNET + POST_NOTIFICATIONS; no privacy URL in listing draft.
categories.why_not_higher: Ship policy URL and trim permissions to features used.

categories.why: Home list has no empty-state illustration/copy when habits.isEmpty.
categories.why_not_higher: Empty, offline, and error states before store submit.

findings.title: Interstitials on every navigation with no frequency cap
findings.why: showInterstitial is called on every route change. That invites accidental taps and policy risk.
findings.counterpoint: Acceptable only if limited to rewarded ads behind an explicit user action.
findings.fix: Cap interstitials (e.g. once per 3 minutes) and never place beside primary CTAs.

findings.title: Notification permission before first habit
findings.why: Permission runs in initState before the user sees value, raising early drop-off risk.
findings.counterpoint: Power users may want reminders immediately — still ask contextually.
findings.fix: Ask when enabling a reminder on a habit.

findings.title: No privacy policy URL while ads/analytics likely
findings.why: Listing draft has no policy link; ads SDK implies data collection.
findings.counterpoint: Not critical until store submission — but goal is earn/live soon.

evidence.quote: Simple streaks. No RPG. No social.

findings.fix: Publish a policy page and link it in-app and on the store listing.

findings.title: Home has no empty state
findings.why: New users see a blank list with no guidance to create a habit.
findings.counterpoint: A FAB alone can be enough for some apps; still weak for first session.
findings.fix: Add empty-state copy + primary Create habit CTA.

strengths.title: Focused one-liner vs RPG habit apps

evidence.quote: Simple streaks. No RPG. No social.

verdict_line: Clear niche, but uncapped ads and permission-before-value will burn the few installs you get.
